title: Pūtanā — Kṛṣṇa’s Astonishing Mercy
scripture_reference: SB 10.6 / Complete Krishna Book Chapter 6 — Putana Killed
summary_seed: After Nanda remembers Vasudeva's warning and takes shelter of the Lord, Kamsa sends the raksasi Putana, who kills infants. She assumes a beautiful form, enters Gokula and Nanda's home, takes baby Krishna on her lap, and offers her poison-smeared breast. Krishna sucks out the poison and her life air; she reveals a gigantic form and falls. Krishna plays fearlessly on her body. Yasoda, Rohini, and the gopis lift Him and perform protective rites while remembering Vishnu's names. Nanda and the cowherd men return. When Putana's body is burned it gives a fragrant aroma because Krishna purified her, and He grants her a motherly destination despite her murderous intention. Faithful hearing brings attachment to Govinda.
